crossfade_specification.sum_property: w_out(t) + w_in(t) == 1.0 (identically for all t in [0, 1])
crossfade_specification.boundary_derivative: d/dt w_out(0) == d/dt w_out(1) == 0.0 (C1 continuity, zero derivative kink)
crossfade_specification.why_not_linear: Linear crossfades have non-zero derivatives at boundaries, causing audible high-frequency clicks ('corners'), and produce a -3dB power dip on incoherent material.
crossfade_specification.why_not_exponential: Exponential decays cannot reach true zero without abrupt truncation, creating DC offsets and non-linear energy sums that swell or pump bass fundamentals.
